_doc: Known sites where code reads external_product_seeds.market (a storage partition) as a market or currency.
Checked by tests/test_seed_partition_is_not_a_market.py: a hit not listed fails, and a listed entry that no longer hits fails.
A PR that moves a site onto services.seed_serving deletes its entry. Keyed (file, qualname, rule), never by line.
finding: an ID from the 2026-11-06 partition audit, N<k> for a site the scanner found beyond it, OK-partition for a legitimate partition use, N/A for a hit that is not the seed partition at all.
